column1: # The driver set the pair-coverage ledger is measured against (#1408).
# Every task `verify` runs, plus `roadmap`, which verify-runner.sh runs after
# the parallel lane. COMMITTED rather than derived at run time: deriving it
# would let the basis drift under a ledger that still claimed to describe it.
# `measure.sh` fails in both directions against Taskfile.yml — a verify task
# missing here is an undriven gate, and an entry verify no longer runs is a
# stale pin. Regenerate by copying the verify list plus `roadmap`.
